description: Flat record-level metadata schema for sequencing-based soil microbiome samples collected from agricultural fields, including soil properties, sampling context, extraction, sequencing, and processing details.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual soil sample or sequencing record.

field_site_id.descr: Identifier for the agricultural field or site where the sample was collected.

sample_name.descr: Local sample name or code used in the laboratory or field notebook.

collection_date.descr: Date the soil sample was collected (YYYY-MM-DD).

country.descr: Country where the sample was collected.

region_state_province.descr: Administrative region, state, or province of collection.

county_district.descr: County, district, or equivalent local administrative area.

latitude.descr: Latitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude.descr: Longitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees (WGS84).

elevation_m.descr: Elevation of the sampling location in meters above sea level.

geolocation_precision_m.descr: Estimated spatial uncertainty of the recorded coordinates in meters.

land_use_type.descr: Primary land use or crop production system (for example: corn, wheat, pasture, fallow).

crop_type.descr: Crop species present at the time of sampling, if applicable.

agricultural_practice.descr: Main agricultural management practice being studied or observed (for example: conventional, organic, regenerative).

tillage_practice.descr: Tillage regime used at the site (for example: no-till, reduced till, conventional till).

fertilization_type.descr: Type of fertilization or amendment applied (for example: synthetic, manure, compost, none).

irrigation_practice.descr: Irrigation regime or status (for example: irrigated, rainfed, drip).

pesticide_use.descr: Whether pesticides were used at the site or on the sampled crop; use controlled terms such as yes/no or categorical classes.

soil_type_classification.descr: Soil classification name or taxonomic class, if known (for example: USDA soil series, FAO class).

sampling_depth_cm.descr: Depth interval of the soil sample in centimeters; record as a numeric value or representative depth for the sampled horizon.

sample_mass_g.descr: Mass of soil collected for the sample in grams.

sampling_method.descr: Description of how the sample was collected (for example: corer, auger, composite sample, hand-sieved).

sampling_replicate.descr: Replicate number or replicate code for samples collected from the same field/site.

sampling_time_local.descr: Local time of day when the sample was collected, if available.

soil_texture.descr: Observed or reported soil texture class (for example: sandy loam, clay loam).

soil_pH.descr: Soil pH measurement, typically in water or CaCl2; specify method in pH_method if needed.

pH_method.descr: Method used to measure soil pH (for example: pH in water, pH in CaCl2).

soil_moisture_percent.descr: Soil moisture content as percent wet weight or gravimetric moisture percentage.

organic_matter_percent.descr: Soil organic matter content as a percentage of dry soil mass.

organic_carbon_percent.descr: Soil organic carbon content as a percentage of dry soil mass.

total_nitrogen_percent.descr: Total nitrogen content as a percentage of dry soil mass.

bulk_density_g_cm3.descr: Soil bulk density in grams per cubic centimeter.

soil_temperature_c.descr: Soil temperature at the time of sampling in degrees Celsius.

nucleic_acid_type.descr: Type of nucleic acid extracted (for example: DNA, RNA, total nucleic acids).

extraction_protocol.descr: Name or short description of the nucleic acid extraction method or kit used.

extraction_kit_manufacturer.descr: Manufacturer or vendor of the extraction kit, if applicable.

extraction_kit_catalog_number.descr: Catalog number of the extraction kit or key reagent, if available.

dna_yield_ng_ul.descr: Nucleic acid concentration after extraction in ng/µL.

dna_purity_ratio_260_280.descr: Purity ratio measured at 260/280 nm, typically for DNA extracts.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument or platform used (for example: Illumina MiSeq, NovaSeq, Oxford Nanopore).

library_prep_kit.descr: Library preparation kit or protocol name used prior to sequencing.

library_id.descr: Identifier for the sequencing library derived from the sample.

barcode_index.descr: Sample barcode or index sequence identifier used for multiplexing.

target_region.descr: Targeted marker region or genomic approach (for example: 16S rRNA V3-V4, ITS2, shotgun metagenome).

primer_forward.descr: Forward primer sequence or identifier used for amplification, if applicable.

primer_reverse.descr: Reverse primer sequence or identifier used for amplification, if applicable.

read_length_bp.descr: Sequencing read length in base pairs for each read, or average read length for long-read data.

paired_end.descr: Indicates whether sequencing was paired-end (true) or single-end (false).

sequencing_depth_reads.descr: Number of raw reads generated for this sample/library.

sequencing_run_id.descr: Identifier of the sequencing run or lane.

raw_data_accession.descr: Accession or file identifier for raw sequence data in an archive or repository.

host_dna_removal.descr: Indicates whether host DNA removal or depletion was performed during processing.

quality_filtering_method.descr: Description of read trimming, filtering, and quality control method used.

quality_threshold.descr: Quality score threshold applied during filtering, if applicable.

adapter_trimming_tool.descr: Software used to remove adapter or primer sequences.

denoising_method.descr: Method used for amplicon denoising or error correction (for example: DADA2, Deblur).

chimera_removal_method.descr: Method used to identify and remove chimeric sequences.

reference_database.descr: Reference database used for taxonomic or functional assignment (for example: SILVA, Greengenes, UNITE, GTDB).

taxonomy_assignment_method.descr: Algorithm or pipeline used for taxonomic classification.

functional_annotation_method.descr: Method or pipeline used for functional annotation of sequences, if applicable.

bioinformatics_pipeline.descr: Name of the main bioinformatic pipeline or workflow used for processing.

pipeline_version.descr: Version of the bioinformatic pipeline, workflow, or software suite.

analysis_date.descr: Date when bioinformatic processing or analysis was performed (YYYY-MM-DD).

otu_asv_count.descr: Number of OTUs or ASVs obtained after processing, depending on the analysis approach.

data_product_type.descr: Type of final processed data product (for example: ASV table, OTU table, taxonomic table, gene family table).

replicate_pooled.descr: Indicates whether field or extraction replicates were pooled before sequencing.

sample_storage_temperature_c.descr: Storage temperature of the sample or extracted nucleic acid in degrees Celsius.

sample_storage_duration_days.descr: Duration from collection to extraction or sequencing storage in days.

notes.descr: Free-text notes on exceptional circumstances, deviations from protocol, or additional context.
